test_name: BOAR grid MapCapture (commissioning build, energized 60 V DC-link)
scope: mapcap build/run/drain with board-qualified BOAR v2 profile (48 points: 6 sectors x 2 windows x 4 points)
commissioning firmware with OEW_MAP_CAPTURE=1, OEW_MAP_L3=1, PWM_OEW_BOARD_REVISION=7, OEW_HS1_COMMISSIONING_RELEASE=1
shunt ADC (STM32G474 ADC1+ADC2 dual injected, TIM1 TRGO sync) is authoritative for current measurement — 8 samples per burst in @MC:REC (raw_i1/raw_i2/i1/i2/vbus)
ACS712 scope evidence is OPTIONAL diagnostic layer (no EXT TRIG available on bench oscilloscope)
logic analyzer: SD1=D0, SD2=D1, PB6=D2; trigger on PB6 rising edge
mandatory energize-only Step E before first burst (trigger on falling SD1/SD2)
breakdiag check after each fault or at session end
prerequisites: Step A 10 V bring-up PASS (see docs/STEP_A_ACCEPTANCE.md)
Approved written procedure and SAFETY_CHECKLIST_PC3.md signed by operator and safety watcher
LOTO plan applied to DC-link supply and motor disconnect
Two-person rule: operator + safety watcher present
Emergency stop within reach of both persons
Motor mechanically secured, shaft cannot spin or engage loads
Fire extinguisher class C/E present and known to both
ACS712 Phase 1 no-HV checkout PASS (calibration JSON available, optional diagnostic)
Logic analyzer armed: SD1=D0, SD2=D1, PB6=D2 (fx2lafw D0-D3 only for trigger)
Energize-only Step E must pass before any burst at 60 V
PB6 sync verified de-energized before armed energized capture (LA D2 must show PB6 pulse)
stop_conditions: FAULT_R=18 with SD1=0 or SD2=0 at ISR entry (real protection trip) — BLOCKED, no reset
FAULT_R=18 with CCER!=0 (PWM was active during break) — BLOCKED, no reset
supply enters current limit or trips
unexpected motion, noise, heating, smoke or smell
shunt ADC i1/i2 both zero or saturated in @MC:REC (zero winding current or ADC fault)
loss of observation by either person

transient_break_policy.description: STEVAL FAULT_N transient: breakdiag sd=1,1 + CCER=0 + idle — allowed reset and continue
conditions_for_reset: breakdiag sd=1,1 (both SD HIGH at ISR entry — transient already gone)
breakdiag ce=0,0 (CCER=0 on both timers — PWM was off)
reset_procedure: save breakdiag snapshot to evidence log
continue with the same or next grid point
transient_break_policy.escalation: if more than 5 transient breaks per session or any non-transient break, session is BLOCKED

scope_waiver.description: ACS712 scope evidence waived for 60V grid campaign
scope_waiver.reason: Bench oscilloscope (FNIRSI-1014D 2ch, Hantek DSO5202P) lacks usable EXT TRIG for PB6 synchronization. Shunt ADC (STM32G474 ADC1+ADC2, dual injected simultaneous, TIM1 TRGO trigger) provides 12-bit, PWM-synchronous, calibrated current samples in every @MC:REC record. At 60V / ~1A, shunt SNR is excellent (signal ~100 ADC counts above offset). LA PB6 trace provides burst timing correlation.
authoritative_evidence: LA: SD1=D0 HIGH, SD2=D1 HIGH, PB6=D2 pulse ~1.67ms (per burst)
breakdiag: valid=0 or documented transient (sd=1,1 ce=0,0)
scope_waiver.optional_diagnostic: ACS712 scope capture if oscilloscope with EXT TRIG becomes available

notes: G0 v4: scope waiver — shunt ADC authoritative, ACS712 scope optional. Step A 10V PASS is a hard prerequisite. Current limit 2A for 60V. BKIN enabled. OEW_SD_MONITOR_ONLY forbidden.
